items.title: Sodexo (ENXTPA:SW) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: Sodexo’s fair value estimate has shifted from €52.66 to €54.63, a change of about 3.7% that fine tunes where analysts see the stock’s long term potential. This sits alongside a series of upward price target moves from more positive houses, even as others keep Neutral or Underweight ratings and cluster in the €50 to €60 range. items.title: Bank of America’s Unrealized Bond Losses Could Top $90 Billion on Surging Yields
items.summary: The paper losses on a large Bank of America bond portfolio could have widened by more than $10 billion to over $90 billion in the current quarter, thanks to the fixed-income market’s blistering selloff.  Bank of America  $506 billion portfolio of low-rate bonds, mostly U.S. agency mortgage securities, has been a sore spot for shareholders.  Bank of America declined to comment Thursday.
